item_summary: $150-250 active noise-canceling over-ear wireless headphones with multipoint connectivity and a boom microphone for remote work
detailed_item_draft: Identify over-ear wireless Bluetooth headphones priced between $150 and $250 USD. Mandatory specifications include Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) for ambient suppression and multipoint Bluetooth pairing to connect two devices simultaneously. The audio profile must prioritize vocal clarity for remote work, specifically featuring a physical boom microphone (detachable or fixed arm) rather than standard embedded arrays. Battery endurance must be at least 20 hours per charge with ANC active. Construction should feature memory foam ear cushions and a padded headband for extended wear comfort. Include USB-C charging port and 3.5mm wired backup option. Ensure physical controls or app support for call management (mute, volume).
